provenance.work: Vaxenburg et al. 2025, Nature (flybody); data on Figshare
provenance.citation: Vaxenburg R. et al. Whole-body physics simulation of fruit fly locomotion. Nature (2025); trajectories from Muijres F.T. et al. Science 344:172-177 (2014) and J Exp Biol 218:864-875 (2015).
provenance.processing: trajectory type evasion_original only; resampled to 1 kHz (every 5th sample of 5 kHz); position relative to the first sample and rotated so the initial body heading is +x; yaw relative to the initial yaw; pitch/roll dropped; wing pattern decimated to 100 samples of one wingbeat. Selected by net yaw: 4 straightest, 2 left, 2 right.

position_unit: dataset length unit, assumed cm (undocumented in the file; implied by ~20 units/s flight speeds)
